title: शव, सालिक र सहस्र बुद्ध कथामा सबाल्टर्न {The Corpse, the Salik and the Subaltern in the Sahasra Buddha Story}
nepali: प्रस्तुत अध्ययन ‘शव सालिक र सहस्र बुद्ध’ कथामा रहेको सबाल्टर्न चेतनाकोउद्घाटनमा केन्द्रित छ । सबाल्टर्न अध्ययन सांस्कृतिक अध्ययन अन्तर्गत पर्ने कृति विश्लेषणको नवीन मान्यता हो । यसले साहित्यमा सबाल्टर्न वर्गको अधीनस्थ अवस्थालाई हेर्छ । राज्यको मूल धारबाट किनारीकृत गरी सीमान्तमा पुर्याइएका निम्न वर्गीय मानिसहरूको पहिचान र प्रतिनिधित्वका पक्षमा यस सिद्धान्तले जोड दिन्छ । इटालेली सौन्दर्य चिन्तक ग्राम्चीद्वारा प्रस्तुत सबाल्टर्न सम्बन्धी मान्यताले समाजमा सदियौँदेखि प्रभुत्वशाली वर्गबाट उत्पीडन सहन बाध्य बनाइएका वर्गको पक्षमा वकालत गर्दछ । यस अध्ययनमा यही मान्यताका आधारमा ‘शव, सालिक र सहस्र बुद्ध’ कथामा सबाल्टर्न अध्ययन गरिएको छ । कथाकी मुख्य पात्र न्हुच्छेमाया राज्यको मूलधारबाट उपेक्षित भएकी सीमान्तीकृत अवस्थामा पुर्याएकी सबाल्टर्न पात्र हो । ऊ वर्गीय, जातीय एबम लैङ्गिक आधारमा सबाल्टर्न पात्र हो भन्ने निष्कर्ष यस अध्ययनबाट प्राप्त भएको छ । ज्ञान र चेतनाको कमीले प्रभुत्वशाली वर्गसँग प्रतिरोध गर्न नसक्ने न्हुच्छेमाया बाचाल हुन नसकेकी सबाल्टर्न पात्र हो । उसको आवाजलाई यहाँ कथाकारले बोलिदिएका छन् भन्ने निष्कर्षसमेत यस अध्ययनबाट प्राप्त भएको छ ।
american_english: This study focuses on the introduction of subaltern consciousness in the 'Corpse, the Salik and the Sahasra Buddha' story. Subaltern studies is a new recognition in cultural studies as a work of critical analysis. It looks at subordinate social classes in literature. It emphasizes the identification and representation of lower classes marginalized by the main power from the beginning and pushed to periphery. The Italian aesthetic thinker Gramsci presented the idea that subaltern means the class that has been continuously suppressed by the dominant class. This study focuses on 'Corpse, the Salik and the Sahasra Buddha' story, based on subaltern theories. The main character in the story is Nhuchhenmaya, a subaltern character marginalized by the main power from the beginning and pushed to periphery. He is a subaltern character based on class, ethnicity and gender. Nhuchhenmaya, due to his lack of knowledge and consciousness, cannot resist the dominant class, a subaltern character who cannot protest. The study concludes that Nhuchhenmaya's voice is expressed through the narrator in the story.
british_english: This study examines the emergence of subaltern consciousness in the narrative 'Corpse, the Salik and the Sahasra Buddha'. Subaltern studies represents a novel approach within cultural studies, focusing on critical analysis of subordinate social classes in literature. It emphasizes the identification and representation of lower-class groups marginalized by dominant power structures from their inception and relegated to peripheral positions. The Italian aesthetic thinker Gramsci conceptualized subaltern as those continuously oppressed by dominant classes. This analysis applies subaltern theories to the 'Corpse, the Salik and the Sahasra Buddha' narrative. The central character, Nhuchhenmaya, exemplifies subaltern identity as he is marginalized by initial power structures and pushed to societal periphery. He represents a subaltern figure defined by class, ethnicity, and gender. Due to his limited knowledge and consciousness, Nhuchhenmaya cannot resist the dominant class, making him a subaltern character incapable of protest. The research concludes that Nhuchhenmaya's voice is articulated through the narrative voice in the story.
australian_english: This paper investigates the introduction of subaltern consciousness in the narrative 'Corpse, the Salik and the Sahasra Buddha'. Subaltern studies is a new critical approach in cultural analysis that examines subordinate social classes in literature. It focuses on identifying and representing lower-class groups that have been marginalized by dominant power structures from their beginning and pushed to the edges of society. Italian aesthetic thinker Gramsci defined subaltern as people continuously oppressed by dominant classes. This study applies subaltern theory to 'Corpse, the Salik and the Sahasra Buddha'. The main character is Nhuchhenmaya, a subaltern character who is marginalized by the main power from the beginning and pushed to periphery. He represents a subaltern character based on class, ethnicity and gender. Due to his lack of knowledge and consciousness, Nhuchhenmaya cannot resist the dominant class, a subaltern character who cannot protest. The conclusion of this study is that Nhuchhenmaya's voice is expressed through the narrator's voice in the story.
informal_english: This paper looks at the emergence of subaltern consciousness in the story 'Corpse, the Salik and the Sahasra Buddha'. Subaltern studies is a new way of looking at culture and literature that focuses on analyzing subordinate social classes. It emphasizes identifying and representing lower-class groups that have been marginalized and pushed to the edges by powerful people from the very beginning. Italian thinker Gramsci described subaltern as people continuously oppressed by dominant classes. This paper applies subaltern theory to 'Corpse, the Salik and the Sahasra Buddha'. The main character is Nhuchhenmaya, a subaltern figure who's been marginalized by the main power from the start and pushed to the periphery. He represents a subaltern character based on class, ethnicity and gender. Because he lacks knowledge and awareness, Nhuchhenmaya cannot resist the dominant class - he's a subaltern character who can't protest. The paper's conclusion is that Nhuchhenmaya's voice is expressed through the narrator's voice in the story.
